newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to auction $100 mln regional bonds June 20.
newsitem.headline: Russia to auction $100 mln regional bonds June 20.

text.p: Russia's Finance Ministry will auction 571.88 billion roubles ($100 million) nominal value regional bonds on June 20 at a minimum price of 88 percent, a senior Finance Ministry official said on Friday.

"We have set a minimum price at which the paper will be placed," the ministry's Securities Department Head Bella Zlatkis told Reuters. "We are presenting six papers of subjects of the federation at the sale."
The sale kicks off a move to restructure and sell as securities debt to the federal government, in this case unrepaid 1996 federal agricultural credits.
Six regions will each issue discount bonds with one, two and three-year maturities, face values of 10 million roubles and 10 percent annual coupons. Discounts will vary by region.
More regions are in the process of preparing issues, which will be traded on the Moscow Interbank Currency Exchange (MICEX), in which foreigners can participate.
IFCI (International Company for Finance and Investments or Bank MFK) will be the trade agent and Uneximbank will act as depositary.
